only-md.description: Allows writes and edits only to Markdown files.

no-env-access.description: Blocks reads and writes to .env files.

paths-in-cwd.description: Blocks read, write, and edit paths that resolve outside the project.
paths-in-cwd.shell: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path");const input=JSON.parse(process.env.PI_TOOL_INPUT);const value=input.path;if(value===undefined||value==="")process.exit(0);if(typeof value!=="string")process.exit(1);const root=fs.realpathSync(process.env.PI_CWD);function resolve(base,target,depth=0){if(depth>40)throw new Error("too many symbolic links");const absolute=path.isAbsolute(target);let current=absolute?path.parse(target).root:base;const rest=absolute?target.slice(path.parse(target).root.length):target;for(const segment of rest.split(path.sep)){if(!segment||segment===".")continue;if(segment===".."){current=path.dirname(current);continue}const candidate=path.join(current,segment);let stat;try{stat=fs.lstatSync(candidate)}catch(error){if(error&&(error.code==="ENOENT"||error.code==="ENOTDIR")){current=candidate;continue}throw error}current=stat.isSymbolicLink()?resolve(current,fs.readlinkSync(candidate),depth+1):candidate}return current}const target=resolve(root,value);const relative=path.relative(root,target);process.exit(relative===""||(!path.isAbsolute(relative)&&relative!==".."&&!relative.startsWith(".."+path.sep))?0:1)'

write-new-files-only.description: Allows write only when the destination path does not exist.

no-env-secrets-in-output.description: Blocks tool results containing qualifying secrets from the project .env file.
